Live-DOM stylesheet iteration was blocked by the Claude-in-Chrome extension's own query-string safety filter on /admin/customers (verified this is a tooling-level block, not content-related, by confirming JS execution works on a query-string-free page); substituted with pixel-measurement of a zoomed screenshot, which found rendered row height ~40px (~67 zoomed px / 1.678 scale), consistent with GRID_DENSITY.comfortable and inconsistent with the removed 42px literal.
